fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2026-05-15, a person claiming to be a recruitment agent took Rs. 2,50,000 from the complainant for a job offer that did not materialise. The time of the incident was given as 15:25 on 2026-05-13. Tamilselvi Devi approached Coimbatore North PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000452. The account reference SYN-ACC-100066 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Karthik Shankar, using the number 9000000306. The complainant mentioned a bank transaction reference and a call detail reference.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Bank transaction reference; Call detail reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly issued a forged offer letter and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: job fraud, cheating, residential colony, mobile number, bank reference, bank account, call detail, afternoon
